subject: general
question: The amount on a sum of ₹3,600 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use formula: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

= 3600 × (1.1)²

= 3600 × 1.21

= 4356

**∴ Answer = ₹4356**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 3600, Rate = 10%, Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 1st year: 3600 × 1.10 = 3960

⇒ After 2nd year: 3960 × 1.10 = 4356

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4356.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest

Interest is added to principal every year.

CI Formula

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Growth Factor

1.1 for 10% per year.

Annual Compounding

Interest calculated once per year.

15
